Netice works without the internet. Your student, exam and result data is stored only on this phone (or computer), in the app's own folder; it is not sent to the developer or any other server.

Data leaves the device only when you choose: when you share a report or backup, or when you turn on the optional Google Drive backup in Settings > Account (the backup goes to your own Google account).

Make a backup before deleting the app; otherwise the data is deleted along with it.
